name: A Simple Date
source:
Cutie, Joy, and Edge are three girls you've had your eye on for a while. Tonight’s the night – you’re going to take one of them on a date! Tell them what they want to hear, and maybe things will go your way.

[From [url=https://jaydalyn.itch.io/a-simple-date]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Cutie、Joy和Edge是你关注已久的三个女孩。今晚就是这样的夜晚——你要带他们中的一个去约会！告诉他们他们想听的话，也许事情会如你所愿。

[来自[url=https://jaydalyn.itch.io/a-simple-date]Itch.io[/url]]
